Name: Instant Shaft
Author: steventhorne
Description:
InstantShaft is a simple QoL mod that skips the confirmation popup when you try to jump in a mine shaft in the Skull Cavern.

This is especially useful in Multiplayer where the game does not pause while asking you if you want to jump in.

[url=https://github.com/steventhorne/stardew-mods/tree/master/InstantShaft]Source[/url]
